Author: Sharad Kumar Sharma Bench: Sharad Kumar Sharma  Office Notes, reports,
SL. orders or proceedings or  Date COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS No directions and Registrar's  order with Signatures  C482 No.337 of 2021  Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Lokendra Dobhal, learned counsel for the applicant.
Mr. Pramod Kumar, learned Brief Holder for the State.
Mr. Pratul Kumar, learned counsel for the private respondent.

This C-482 application has been preferred by the present applicant wherein he has put a challenge to the proceedings of Criminal Case No.261 of 2020, "State Vs. Sanjeev Nayan and Others", wherein the cognizance have been taken against him for the offences under Section 406, 420, and 120-B of IPC and consequent to which summoning order has been issued on 28.09.2020.

entities.text: State Vs. Sanjeev Nayan and Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Today, the matter is listed on two compromise applications i.e. IA No.2 of 2021 and IA No.4 of 2022 wherein the terms of the settlement has been deciphered, therein that the parties to the proceedings have settled their dispute in accordance with the contents of terms referred to in the compromise applications.
Since, all the offences for which summons have been issued to the applicant are compoundable under Section 320 of the Cr.P.C.
The present C-482 application would stand allowed in terms of the compromise application.
Accordingly, the proceedings of Criminal Case No.261 of 2020, "State Vs. Sanjeev Nayan and Others", so far as it relates to the present applicant, would hereby stand quashed.

entities.text: State Vs. Sanjeev Nayan and Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the C-482 application would stand disposed of.

(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 22.03.2023 Sukhbant C482/337/2021 on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79986877/
